####Lab 8

group_by(col) gives unique groups of a specific col

pipe a summarize(across(where(is.numeric), ~mean(.x, na.rm=T))) after a group and it gives you a summary of a equation for that group.


####Lab 9

pivot_longer(-col we're catorgorizing by
              names_to= "new col representing multiple cols",
              values_to= "values of old multiple cols")
Takes an unnecessarily wide table and converts it into a long table moving cols into values and shifting the values attached to old cols with them

pivot_longer(col:col,      gives a specific range to pivot
            values_drop_na=T) in end drops all NA's in values.
